title: Odile and the Interior
author: Odile Whitlock
blurb: Vesper Eriksen, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
